data.name: Z12
data.detailed_description:
Z12 is a cinematic, story-rich 3D action-adventure infused with puzzle-solving, platforming, and creature encounters, set across twelve ancient realms shaped by cosmic architecture. Awaken alone in a world, drawn forward by a force unknown. Every structure feels intentional, every symbol looks like a message, and every creature that stands in your way seems to be protecting forbidden celestial knowledge.

Z12 is not about violence; it’s about understanding. You face guardians, shifting entities and elemental creatures awaken because of your intrusion of the sacred grounds. Some strike when threatened, others test your patience, movement and timing. Read their patterns, break their defenses, and tackle them at the right moment to survive and progress. Through combat, you learn how these beings think, and why they guard the path ahead.

Explore the Twelve Houses

Each realm is a world of its own.

Locked doors that open through puzzle completion.

Stone mechanisms that respond to symbols and energy.

Rooms shaped by elemental rules.

Every realm teaches a new mechanics the player must master to progress.

Gameplay Features

Cinematic action-adventure with exploration and environmental puzzles.

Challenges driven by physics, timing and observation Narrative told through architecture, symbols and visual discovery.

Atmospheric world-building with cosmic temples, shifting geometry, ancient machines.

Replay able house challenges for mastery and completion rewards.

Your Goal

Restore the ancient mechanism at the core of Z12 - a cosmic engine linking all twelve houses.

To unlock it, you must

  • Learn the rules of each house

  • Master its movement style

  • Reconnect its broken channels

  • Survive the final convergence event

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
